description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR2, independent of the other two. plan_entry_dispatch (src/compiler2/jobs/dispatch.rs ~110-119) waits on FactKey::ModuleDefined(owner_module) and never consumes its value; it then asks for exactly TypeDefined, StructDefined, GuardDispatch and FunctionDefined. Delete the gate. Verify first by probe that entry_source_patterns has no unstated dependency on module scoping. Test: the Provider/make_answer case: EntryDispatch(make_answer) settles while ModuleDefined(Provider) is absent, records only its exact function/type/struct reads, and an unrelated module edit causes zero recomputation, asserted from the job trace. Other ModuleDefined waits (jobs/keying.rs, jobs/semantic.rs) carry their own justification and stay.

comments.text: User decision: a module invoking a macro it defines in its own body is rejected as Elixir rejects it (undefined function make_answer/0: a module's macros are not callable until the module is compiled). The gate deletion stays (unconsumed wait); module_local_item_macro becomes an expect: diagnostic fixture and the entry-planning test stages demand directly.

title: Delete the ModuleDefined blanket gate on entry planning
